title: This is my Arcadevania Sylv and The Ancient Tree! Launching September 21. I've used some IA for sprites, code and music, but all elements were edited and fixed almost pixel by pixel to keep the visual style.
author: DazzlingTop6203
selftext:
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4589200/Sylv\_and\_the\_Ancient\_Tree/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4589200/Sylv_and_the_Ancient_Tree/)

Hello, all you devs! Let me introduce you to the game I’ve been working on for the last two years. I wanted to make a retro game paying homage to great classics such as the Wonder Boy series, Alex Kidd and Zelda 2… A sort of blend combining exploration, platforming and combat. I’ve used AI for the music, for some sprites and to help me with the code, but I haven’t used Agents or advanced AI – just free tools. The game is out on 21 September – in 3 days’ time!
